parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 6 dropped val_bpb from 1.092 to 1.076. The increased capacity seems to be paying off despite the fixed 5-minute budget. I will now focus on fine-tuning the learning rate and aspect ratio for this new depth.
parsed.description: Adopt the new depth (6) and try a higher learning rate with a reduced aspect ratio to improve computational efficiency and convergence speed.
